meta.description: Block 2 of Experiments 1 and 2: the projectivity and at-issueness of the occasion implication of German occasion verbs, and of the implications of stimulus-experiencer and experiencer-stimulus psychological verbs, measured in the paradigm of Tonhauser, Beaver and Degen (2018) by certain-that and asking-whether questions on a slider, transformed to [0, 1] with 1 the maximal projectivity and the maximal at-issueness. The established triggers run alongside (possessive NP, NRRC, stop, know, discover, personal pronoun, demonstrative in Experiment 1; appositives, again, too, cleft, implicative, definites besides in Experiment 2) are plotted only.
